summary: Added request-local unit template normalization and deterministic forbidden-expression auditing. analyze_payload now returns unit_template_profile and forbidden_expression_audit, build_prompt appends a separate unit template constraints section when configured, and explicit unit/payload forbidden expressions create paragraph-targeted fail issues without duplicate issue spam. No model call, model rewrite, semantic similarity, paraphrase matching, or NLI.
